sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For generations, our foundry has stood for craftsmanship and true partnership in our region. We have reviewed your counter-offer and are pleased to accept the 24-month contract term to foster our continued partnership. This main proposal stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

However, a 60-day payment term is difficult for our operations, so we propose a fair compromise of 45 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €52.00 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

As a family-run business that values trust and reliability, we expect our negotiations to progress constructively. Our foundry has stood for quality and strong regional partnerships for generations, and we deeply value the long relationship between our companies. With this shared history in mind, we maintain our offer of €52.20 for the 24-month contract with a 60-day payment term. 

To be precise, our offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust that this proposal reflects our continued commitment to a reliable partnership, and we look forward to moving these discussions forward in a positive spirit.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Our family foundry has stood in this region for generations, built on honest work, pride in our craftsmanship, and long-standing partnerships. As a family-run foundry that values reliability, we expect negotiations to move forward rather than backward.

Therefore, we maintain our offer of €52.20 for the 24-month contract with a 60-day payment term. To be completely precise, our Angebot stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

We value our ongoing relationship and look forward to hearing your confirmation so we may continue our work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
